privacy.h3: 3. Photos and recordings sent to the AI assistant
privacy.p1: Your name, phone number, email (if provided), vehicle details, service history, and anything you send to the AI assistant — text, photos and voice recordings.
privacy.p2: To confirm and remind you of bookings, carry out the service, keep your bike’s service history, and improve our service. We do not sell data to third parties.
privacy.p3: Photos and recordings are used only for that diagnosis session and are deleted automatically after the retention period set by the store (30 days by default).
privacy.p4: You can ask the store to show, correct or delete your personal data. Some information tied to completed service records is kept for quality management.
privacy.p5: You can turn notifications off in your account settings. Booking confirmations are still sent, as they are necessary for the transaction.
privacy.title: Personal data policy

terms.p1: These terms apply to the online booking service for motorcycle maintenance and repair at the AOYAMA stores of Mobility Enshu Railway.
terms.p2: A booking becomes valid once the store confirms it. You can change or cancel online up to 2 hours before the appointment; after that, please contact the store directly.
terms.p3: Any work beyond what you booked is quoted first and carried out only with your agreement. At this stage, payment is taken at the store only.
terms.p4: Results from the AI assistant, including the estimated match, are for reference only. The final judgement is always made by a technician after inspecting the bike.
terms.p5: You are responsible for the accuracy of the information you provide, including the phone number for notifications and your vehicle details.
terms.title: Terms of use
